scenario: Deep 180-day Munger rice farmer memory palace for Gemma 4 capability showcase
notes: Extends data/seed/memory_palace.json. Loaded by app.services.demo_seed.seed_demo_memory_palace_deep(). Demonstrates: 128K long memory, multimodal trail (photo+voice+text), multi-scope coarsening, k-anonymity cluster intel, sustainable-first manuals, follow-up loops, proactive outbreak warning.

extra_observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Pre-season soil card showed pH 6.8, low K, medium OC. Lime not needed; potash split planned.
actions: Use soil card before urea top-dressing.
warnings: Do not apply extra urea on lush green leaves.

extra_observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Voice note (Hindi) — nursery sowing complete, asked about seed rate for SRI.
extra_observations.outcome: Agreed on 5 kg/acre Swarna-Sub1 with 25x25 cm spacing.

extra_observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Transplanting done in 2.5 acres, canal water adequate.
extra_observations.outcome: All seedlings transplanted in one day.
actions: Maintain 2-3 cm standing water for first week.

extra_observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Photo of barnyard grass and echinochloa between rows.
extra_observations.outcome: Mechanical weeding done by labour; herbicide deferred.
actions: Prefer mechanical weeding for first round.
warnings: Do not apply post-emergence herbicide if rice is under 3-leaf stage.

extra_observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: First urea top-dressing 30 kg in 2.5 acres at active tillering.
actions: Second urea dose at panicle initiation, not before.

extra_observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Photo at 47 DAT — dark green canopy, no visible stress.
DEMO_MEMORY: Voice note (Bhojpuri) — asked about yellow patches in NE corner.
extra_observations.outcome: Diagnosed as zinc deficiency, advised ZnSO4 foliar spray 0.5%.
warnings: Do not mix Zn with phosphate fertilizer in same spray.

extra_observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Photo — small oval brown spots on lower leaves after 3 cloudy days.
extra_observations.outcome: Drainage improved, urea paused, spots did not progress.
warnings: Do not spray fungicide unless lesions exceed 5% leaf area.

extra_observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Stem borer moth light-trap caught 14 moths in one night, dead hearts at 1 per 20 hills.
extra_observations.outcome: Below ETL; continued scouting, no spray.
actions: Release Trichogramma cards if pressure rises.

extra_observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Voice note (Hindi) — asked when to apply 2nd urea.
extra_observations.outcome: Advised wait till panicle initiation at ~70 DAS.

extra_observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Photo of brown planthoppers clustering on lower stem at base of hill.
extra_observations.outcome: Hot-spot identified; spot treatment with neem oil + alleyway drainage.
actions: Spot-spray neem oil 5 ml/L on hot-spots.
warnings: Do NOT use pyrethroids — they cause BPH resurgence.

extra_observations.text: DEMO_MEMORY: Panicle initiation visible; applied 2nd urea 25 kg/acre as planned.
DEMO_MEMORY: Mandi modal price for paddy Rs 2080/qtl vs MSP Rs 2300. Considering hold.
extra_observations.outcome: Decision deferred till outbreak risk and storage cost evaluated.

extra_ndvi_weekly.note: DIP — cloudy week + brown spot stress event at day 92

extra_finance_entries.description: DEMO: Soil health card lab fee
DEMO: neem oil spot spray for BPH

alert_clusters.broadcast_message: BPH hot-spots reported in Bariarpur and 2 nearby villages. Drain fields and avoid pyrethroids — they cause resurgence.
Brown spot rising in humid pockets across Jamalpur. Improve drainage, pause urea, scout lower leaves.
Karnal bunt traces found in wheat samples — advisory for next rabi sowing, use certified seed.

field.summary: Field Purab Wala Khet: clay loam, pH 6.8, canal-irrigated, prone to brown spot in humid pockets.
First urea applied at 48 DAS, second at 65 DAS — tillering and panicle response both healthy.
BPH hot-spot observed at 135 DAS, controlled without pyrethroid — IPM compliance maintained.
NDVI dipped to 0.46 in week 14 then recovered to 0.69 — stress event resolved.
Farmer prefers Hindi voice notes; switched to Bhojpuri once during stress query.

village.summary: Bariarpur village shows recurring BPH pressure in reproductive stage; 4 farmers reporting.
Village preference: canal irrigation over tube-well, FYM-heavy nutrition pattern.

tehsil.summary: Munger Sadar tehsil: brown spot + BPH dual pressure in this kharif, humid cloudy windows the common trigger.
Mandi modal price tracking below MSP for paddy in last 2 weeks across tehsil.

district.summary: Munger district outbreak watch: BPH severity 0.62 in 4 villages; brown spot severity 0.55 in 6.
District-wide canal water availability stable; no drought stress signals.

state.summary: Bihar kharif 2026: rice sowing on time, MSP gap visible in eastern districts.
State sustainable-first IPM compliance encouraged — NIPHM rice IPM package referenced.

national.summary: All-India paddy MSP 2025-26 Rs 2300/qtl common variety, Rs 2320/qtl grade A.

follow_up_loops.outcome: Applied as advised — healthy panicle emergence confirmed.
Awaiting farmer reply after weather + outbreak risk review.

proactive_outbreak.message_hi: ⚠️ चेतावनी: अगले 2 दिनों में मुंगेर सदर में ब्राउन प्लांटहोपर का खतरा बढ़ने की संभावना है। खेत का पानी निकालें और पाइरेथ्राइड स्प्रे से बचें।
proactive_outbreak.message_en: ⚠️ Early warning: BPH risk rising in Munger Sadar in next 2 days. Drain fields and avoid pyrethroids — they cause BPH resurgence.
